name: Shadow Puppets
description: A shadow-puppet theatre: jointed black silhouette puppets on visible rods, pressed against a warm backlit paper screen that glows and flickers like a flame, with cut-out scenery, a wooden stage frame and fable lines in an elegant serif. Puppets slide in on their rods and act with simple jointed moves (a beak that opens, a jaw that talks, a head that tilts, legs that step). Scenery pieces slide behind them, the light flickers and breathes, and each beat of the story is narrated in a serif line at the bottom before the moral closes the curtain.
best_use_cases: Telling a fable with shadow puppets
style: Shadow-puppet theatre; jointed black silhouette puppets on visible rods; warm backlit paper screen glowing and flickering like a flame; cut-out scenery; wooden stage frame; fable lines in elegant serif.
